name: Calis
title: Chemical Weapons Dealer (of Mount Haven)

racialPassive.name: Amorphous Form
racialPassive.description: Immune to kill shots, able to fit through a 1 inch gap, as well as shapeshifting while still looking like ooze-kin.

racialAbility.name: Acidic Slime
racialAbility.description: All Melee Actions have Acidic Element if direct touch using a Secondary Action allows a higher Exposure level to all Melee Actions this applies to anything besides the Ooze-kin itself.

characterPassive.name: Catalytic Growth
characterPassive.description: Every successful potion, poison, acid, or alchemical item crafted grants 1 Catalyst Stack (max 5). Each stack gives +1 Chemistry and +1 damage/healing on alchemical creations. Stacks are consumed by powerful abilities.

characterAbility.name: Adaptive Mutation
characterAbility.description: Spend 2–5 Catalyst Stacks to temporarily mutate your slime body. 2 stacks: Elastic Form – +3 Agility and climb walls. 3 stacks: Dense Form – +3 Defense and resistance to knockback. 4 stacks: Caustic Form – Acid damage is increased and melee attacks leave lingering corrosion. 5 stacks: Mist Form – Huge bonus to Stealth and can slip through cracks. Lasts 3 turns, then inflicts Fatigue.

occupationPassive: When successfully attacking with alchemy, Smarts +2.
